notes.title: Disturbing New Forbidden Solitaire Trailer Unleashed
notes.notes: [p][/p][previewyoutube="pnvPxVgMtqc;full"][/previewyoutube][p]We're horrified to announce that a new unseen trailer for the banned 1995 title [b]Forbidden Solitaire[/b] has surfaced. Bizarrely, it seems to contain some audio of the original developers at the now defunct [i]Heartblade Interactive[/i], along with grisly clips from the game itself.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45477020/7401b56500806524afd4c2ed46900d00bf70aebd.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Tiny Teams[/h2][p]In further concerning news, this title has been included in Yogscast Games' [url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/TinyTeams2025"]Tiny Teams 2025[/url] event, which starts today. If you encounter any streamers in possession of a short demo build of the game, please exercise [i]extreme[/i] caution.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45477020/d7cd59384548e793e2f9e892043faef998eece2c.gif"][/img][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3414580/Forbidden_Solitaire/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Forbidden Solitaire is an upcoming horror game about a cursed CD-ROM from the spookily distant year of 1995
notes.notes: If I were presented with the opportunity to purchase and place into my disk drive a very obviously cursed CD from 1995 I would simply not do so. This is, of course, what sets me apart from the protagonist of Forbidden Solitaire, a person who would put a cursed disk into their computer and pay the requisite karmic price. (What we have in common is that our PCs still have a disk drive.).. Read more.

notes.title: Thank You for over 7,000 Wishlists in 48 Hours!
notes.notes:
You were warned. And yet, you persist.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45477020/d97862fa104d3851b52ce13889ebdb2dfbab015b.gif[/img]
